units.rawText: Professor, having heard that you seek to discover one's past, Kimie has thus prepared the record of our bond. May it aid in your recovery.
units.displayText: Professor, having heard that you seek to discover one's past, Kimie has thus prepared the record of our bond. May it aid in your recovery.

spans.text: Professor, having heard that you seek to discover one's past, Kimie has thus prepared the record of our bond. May it aid in your recovery.

units.rawText: Wandering about as one did, Kimie collected the knowledge she encountered along the way. Even on that lonesome travail, this Kimie often heard news of you, Professor. Thus, may these memories bring you clarity. Those esteemed words you have imparted upon Kimie as thoust helped built the Kurenoyume Shrine, are too well-preserved and recorded within.

units.rawText: Ah... greatest apologies... Kimie once again can't help but...
units.displayText: Ah... greatest apologies... Kimie once again can't help but...

spans.text: Ah... greatest apologies... Kimie once again can't help but...

units.rawText: It's nothing. Thank you, Kimie. The data you gathered is very important... Hm, what might this omamori be...

units.rawText: Kimie has created an omamori of safety for the sake of everyone at the Oasis. Ever since forging these bonds, this Kimie has felt a deep desire within to give back as much as she has been granted to the Oasis.

units.rawText: Professor, be it the construction of the Kurenoyume Shrine or the light of enlightenment you've shared with thee, Kimie treasures every act of your kindness. I pledge myself to your path, ever striving to return your favor.

units.rawText: Kimie will pray for the Professor at the Kurenoyume Shrine... May the Gods always shine their favor upon thee.
